item.title: bt-4: bt-4: a fully landed stack is no longer the live stack (#928)

results.statement: Each sprint's diff must add only the code its named issues require, with no new scripts, checks or process steps.
results.quote: Keep them short and focused.  This repo already has 10x more code than it should.
results.context: planning session 2026-11-15 (phase-bt release scope)
results.deterministic_check: diff review: every added file and function traces to a named issue's deliverable
results.explanation: The directive is carried forward.

results.statement: Each of issues #938, #937, #979, #986, #928, #922, #907, #906, #904, #932 and #935 must be named by at least one sprint in the phase-bt plan.
results.quote: Create sprints for all these items as outlined above.  Keep them short and focused.
results.context: planning session 2026-11-15 (phase-bt release scope)

results.statement: The dev must not rerun full lint and test after the final rebase unless the rebase required resolving conflicts in code the sprint wrote.
results.quote: Rebasing on top of stack AND make sure tests/lint pass 100% are impossible to both achieve if 5-15 minutes of testing are run after rebase. I have seen agents looping over run tests <-> rebase 10+ times in a row before they can land the stack. 4e could add 'unless conflicts with code written must be resolved' or similar.

results.statement: The dev task must state in a few words that the parent bead closes after its children, with enforcement left to the bd close failure and no hook or script.

No hook/python for this at all outside of returning close fail message from failed 'bd close'.
